title: Unnamed president and wife see a ship while fishing on the coast
summary: Kiran Ilum Xenov tells of Unnamed president and wife see a ship while fishing on the coast, about Unspecified at Coast of an unnamed large country (G7 member), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Coast of an unnamed large country (G7 member)

tellings.quote: The president and his wife, the first lady, were on vacation on the coast fishing, and this ship was descending there.

plain: A guest on a podcast, Kiran Ilum Xenov, introduced as the president of a republic within Russia, says he was told that the president of a large country, one of the G7 group of wealthy nations, saw a strange craft. According to him, the president and his wife were on holiday fishing on the coast when a ship came descending toward them. If true, it would mean a sitting world leader has seen such a craft with his own eyes.
